profile_text.body:
Dropbox is a for-profit public company founded in 2007 and headquartered in San Francisco, California, that provides cloud storage, file sharing, and collaboration tools. The company describes itself as offering secure, easy cloud storage with features including synced team folders, file previews for more than 175 file types, and a product called Dash, which it describes as a way to organize all company content in one place.

On the AI side, Dropbox offers a product called Dropbox AI, categorized under notes, knowledge, and meetings, which the company describes as providing document summaries, team data access, and sharing controls. The site also notes integrations with leading AI platforms that allow users to summarize content, create shared links, and save work back to Dropbox without switching tools, with built-in AI summaries described as coming soon.

Dropbox is listed on a public exchange under the ticker DBX and carries the SEC CIK number 0001467623. The company reported revenue of $2,521,000,000 for the period ending December 31, 2025, as disclosed in a 10-K filing. Dropbox also has a presence in the MCP server registry through a third-party server that enables searching, browsing, and reading Dropbox files, including finding documents by name or content and listing folders.
